In addition to the two main walls, which are re-bated, there is also a south wall and an east wall forming three sides of a small enclosure area outside the main building.
The top of the flue is then rebated with a 6½″ flue and heated in the cupola.
The outer flange has to be cut back slightly if it is to re-bate the inner flange properly and not cause an over-thick flange.
The stones were shaped with diamond tools and then re-bated to fit in their places.
